findings.claim: The new vi.mock factory for StatusBadge.jsx returns only STATUS_LABELS and default and drops every other export of the learner's module. A correct solution that also exports a small helper from StatusBadge.jsx and uses it in ServiceCard is rejected with a test-internal error. Reproduced in a scratch copy: adding a statusTitle helper export used by ServiceCard to a correct solution makes t3 fail with '[vitest] No "statusTitle" export is defined on the "../starter/src/components/StatusBadge.jsx" mock. Did you forget to return it from "vi.mock"?'. The task contract only requires the default and STATUS_LABELS exports, so this alternative is uncommon, but valid.
findings.recommendation: Spread the original module into the mock ({ ...actual, default: <spy> }) so extra exports pass through, and keep only the default export wrapped in the spy.
